title: Club Membership: employer-funded reimbursement of the early-termination fee
content:
## Scope
This document states, for the Club Membership early-termination fee charge, the basis on which an employer-linked benefit partially reimburses the prorated amount, and the cap on that reimbursement.

## Rule
Where the member is also the customer of an active corporate wellness enrollment, that linked employer partnership tier's own wellness reimbursement percentage, combined additively with that same partnership tier's own multi-location discount percentage, reduces the prorated amount by that combined percentage. The dollar amount of that reduction is capped so that it never exceeds the employer partnership tier's own annual wellness-reimbursement cap for this single charge.

## Condition table
| Member's corporate wellness enrollment | Reimbursement basis applied |
|---|---|
| Linked and active | Combined wellness reimbursement and multi-location discount percentage, capped in dollars at the employer tier's own annual wellness-reimbursement cap for this charge |
| Linked but not active | None |
| No linked enrollment | None |

## Points of judgement
Where the percentage-based reduction computed from the combined percentage would exceed the employer partnership tier's own annual wellness-reimbursement cap for this charge, the dollar reduction actually applied is capped at that annual figure rather than the larger percentage-based figure; where the percentage-based reduction is smaller than that cap, the smaller percentage-based figure is the one applied.
